## Continuum 0.5.6

- **Phone screenshots on the PC clipboard now work on Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO phones** (MIUI and HyperOS). Those phones report a new screenshot differently from Pixel phones, so it was being missed. Take a screenshot, then press Ctrl+V on the computer.
- New website: a Light/Dark switch shows the apps in either style.

Update the phone app from inside Continuum (Settings → Check for updates), or download the APK below. The computer updates with your normal system updates.
